shipped_changes.change: Checkout now stores each valid payment-pending order in qpvOrderLedger and links directly to local admin by orderId.
New browser-local admin ledger with order list, selected proof, KPI counters, manual paid/delivered status controls, copy/export JSON and clear ledger action.
Buyer/product path now includes local admin ledger so payment-pending leads have a reviewable operational path.

regression_evidence.evidence: checkout validate() still rejects missing brand/contact/product/ctaText/photoCount and invalid photoCount outside 1-12 before any ledger write.
new orders are created with paymentStatus payment_pending and fulfillmentStatus lead; admin revenueCountedEur is 0 unless paymentStatus is paid/delivered or fulfillmentStatus delivered.
upsertLedger() filters duplicate orderId, appends the order, persists qpvOrderLedger, and keeps qpvLastCheckoutOrder for customer status page compatibility.
order-admin computes orders, pending, paid/delivered, and confirmed EUR from the local ledger and does not count payment_pending rows.
fulfillment change only sets paymentStatus to paid when fulfillmentStatus becomes delivered; otherwise it preserves current paymentStatus.
order-admin exports JSON containing exportedAt, product, orders, and confirmedRevenueEur.
Needs manual browser test on GitHub Pages after deployment cache refresh.

measurable_product_state_movement.before: Checkout created only last-order proof plus per-order JSON export; multiple leads could be lost or not reviewed as a queue.
measurable_product_state_movement.after: Checkout now creates a browser-local order queue with admin review, manual paid gate and exportable ledger, enabling lead follow-up and paid-order tracking.

rejected_weak_patterns: No staffing plan or policy-only change counted as shipping.
No fake revenue: payment_pending remains 0 EUR confirmed.
No admin page that auto-counts unpaid leads as sales.
No payment request without order proof and operational review path.
next_executable_task: Add import/paste order JSON into order-admin.html so downloaded checkout orders from other browsers/devices can be added to the ledger before a real backend exists.
